column1: # leveltime: the -O ladder decided on CPU TIME. Instructions retired are a
# diagnostic and a tiebreak here, not the ranking basis.
# cost_pct  stage-1 self-compile of src/mcc.c, flag OFF against the shipped
#           set. NEGATIVE means the flag COSTS compile time.
# gain_pct  stage-2 -- the compiler that comes out of stage-1, compiling
#           src/mcc.c at -O2. POSITIVE means the flag PAYS.
# gain_insn stage-2 instructions retired, same sign convention. Immune to
#           code layout, so it says whether a time delta is a transform.
# Both are medians of 40 interleaved reps, CPU time (user+sys) from wait4.
# EMPIRICAL FLOORS, measured rather than assumed:
#   stage-1 0.544%  -- 4 IDENTICAL configs, 40 reps each, median to median
#   stage-2 0.435%  -- the 15 configs whose stage-1 object is BYTE IDENTICAL
#                    to the base. Their true effect is exactly zero, so the
#                    spread of what they measured IS the floor. It is wider
#                    than the identical-config floor because changing the
#   kernels, by linking a padding TU ahead of an UNCHANGED kernel -- not one
#   emitted instruction of the kernel differs, only its addresses:
#   That is the headline caveat of this whole table: on interp and sieve,
#   layout alone is worth a third of the runtime, which is 30x any flag.
# THE PREMISE TEST -- the whole ladder, before and after, 40 interleaved reps
# `before` is the shipped level with every moved row put back, restricted to
# the rows whose OLD level was at or below it, so each pair differs by
# exactly what that level lost. + means AFTER is better.
# THE SUBSET THE PREMISE TEST PUT BACK. Demoted with the rest, -O2 stage-2
# went 0.52% slower on 0.25% more instructions. reg-color alone accounts for
# it, and restoring it beats BOTH the reduced ladder and the one it replaces:
# PER-KERNEL CPU TIME for every (flag, kernel) pair whose binary changed,
# 21 interleaved reps, beside the layout-immune counter and that kernel's
# own layout floor. A pair is only evidence when it clears its own floor.
